biocs.name: Process Connected to Rare External Host
biocs.description: A process connects to an IP address that is not commonly seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip != null
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
